title: fix(fields): an action's lookup param honours the borrowed field's allowCreate, and a quick-created record outside lookupFilters is not selected
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_
Fixes #36865

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziG2t1d9cfRQJDrHkB

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在操作弹窗（记录页头与列表勾选工具栏）里选关联记录时，若字段声明不允许新建，就不再出现“+ 新建”；若新建出的记录不符合字段的筛选条件，它不会被选上，选择框会重新打开并说明原因。
- 属于“查找选择框”体验收口，替报销应用里“按出差申请报销”这类只该选已批准记录的操作解决问题。
- 出错时最坏是用户在带筛选的选择框里新建后记录没被选上而需要重选，或按字段配置看不到新建入口；改动可整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

**Half 1: a field-backed lookup param reads the field's `allowCreate`.** A param written `{ field, objectOverride }` already inherited `lookupFilters`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize` and `descriptionField` from the field it borrows, but not `allowCreate`. The resolver's `lookupExtras` now copies it. App-shell's `paramToField` forwards it to the record-header dialog's picker, and plugin-grid's `toBulkParam` carries it to the selection toolbar's dialog, which is the card's repro path. `@object-ui/core`'s exported `ActionParamDef` gains the optional `allowCreate` member it travels on; this is the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration. `allowCreate` also joins `RESOLVED_ONLY_PARAM_KEYS`, because the spec's `ActionParamSchema` does not declare it, so an author who writes it on a raw param is warned by name. The authoring-type parity pin in `@object-ui/types` gains the matching tenth `ts-expect-error` row. No spec or server file changes.

**Half 2: a quick-created record is selected only if the picker could have offered it.** I chose the re-read option. After a create (both the modal form path and the one-field inline fallback), `LookupField` re-reads the new id through the picker's own filter, `popoverFilter` (the field's `lookupFilters` plus the `dependsOn` scope) merged with the id through `mergeFilterNodes`. That is the same query shape the recently-used rail already sends, so the server decides admissibility exactly as it does for listed candidates. This needs no new server API. If the record is absent from the answer, it is not selected and the picker reopens. The existing `createError` slot then shows the new string `lookup.createdOutsideFilters`: "The record was created, but it does not match this field's filters, so it cannot be chosen here." The string is in all 11 locale packs: zh-Hans, ja and es written by hand, the rest translated rather than echoed in English, plus the `FIELD_DEFAULTS` row. A failed re-read shows its error and does not select; it is never read as a pass. A picker with no filter, or no data source to ask, selects as before and makes no extra request.

The `canCreate` gate (the field's `allowCreate` and `resolveAffordance('lookupCreateNew')`) is untouched. It is still the one place create shows, on both the popover (the pinned footer from the earlier popover work) and the phone drawer.

## Tests

New pins, each with a premise run on main and an ablation:

- `paramToField.allowCreate-36865.test.tsx` (app-shell): the real record-header chain, `resolveActionParam` then `paramToField` then `LookupField`. With `allowCreate: false`, the popover (1280 px) and the drawer (390 px) show no create entry. CONTROL: `allowCreate: true` shows it on both faces.
- `bulkFieldBackedParam-12105.test.tsx` (plugin-grid, a new top-level describe in the existing harness): the real toolbar fold, `resolvePromotedBulkParams` then `bulkParamToField` then `LookupField`. It has the same rows and CONTROL on both faces.
- `LookupField.quickCreateFilters-36865.test.tsx` (fields):
  - modal create of a record that fails the filters: not selected, and the line shows;
  - CONTROL: a record that passes is selected, with no line;
  - the inline create is held the same way;
  - the re-read carries the field's filter and the new id;
  - CONTROL: a field with no filter selects without a re-read.

<details><summary>Premise on main: the fix sources restored to the merge base, pins from HEAD</summary>

```

 x the bulk widget field carries the field's allowCreate
 x allowCreate: false - no create entry in the desktop popover   (bulk)
 x allowCreate: false - no create entry in the phone drawer      (bulk)
 x the resolved widget field carries the field's allowCreate
 x allowCreate: false - no create entry in the desktop popover   (record header)
 x allowCreate: false - no create entry in the phone drawer      (record header)
Tests  10 failed | 14 passed (24)
```
The tenth red in that run was the no-filter CONTROL, caused by test isolation: a record selected in an earlier row joined the recently-used list. The file now clears localStorage between rows. In the re-run on main with that fix, the half-2 file read 3 failed and 2 passed, with both CONTROLs green.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Local narrowing is declared; CI runs the full farm. The UI package type-checks were NOT MEASURED locally: each `type-check` script needs the `ui/` workspace `dist` declarations built, and the first errors were TS6305 and TS2307 on unbuilt neighbours, not on this diff. `Type Check UI` in CI is the reading.
- Of the 42 locally derived gate commands, 41 exited 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was killed (SIGKILL) on the shared box, and its registration-pin suite needs a built Console bundle. It is NOT MEASURED locally, and CI's run is the reading.
- Browser reach: NOT MEASURED. The pins drive the real resolver, adapters and widget on both faces under happy-dom. A HotCRM boot to repeat the card's click path was not taken at size S.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.quickCreateFilters-36865.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.allowCreate-36865.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkFieldBackedParam-12105.test.tsx` should show 3 files and 24 tests passed.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`, `admitCreated`: the filter re-read, the not-selected branch and the reopen.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts`, `toBulkParam`: the toolbar carry.
3. `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`, `ActionParamDef.allowCreate`: the published widening.
